title: Fouche: the TR3B uses internal mass reduction

tellings.quote: cuz fuch was adamant that the TR3B is not anti-gravity. It's internal mass reduction. It's to reduce the weight the mass of the TR3B by I think 89%.

plain: The TR3B, said to be a secret triangular American aircraft of the 1990s, does not use anti-gravity but "internal mass reduction," cutting the craft's weight and mass by, as he recalls it, about 89%. That is how the online researcher of UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs) known as UAPGerb relays the claim of Edgar Fouche, a man who said he had worked on secret aircraft programs, adding that Fouche "was adamant" about it. If true, it would mean the US has flying craft built on physics far beyond anything public.
